apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 180 adds the opt-in Mobile Game controller preset: independently positioned on-screen controls, split movement/look touch surfaces with direction indicators, sprint by pushing the movement finger to the rim, and combined Aim + Fire. Adds an immersive option to hide the top stream controls and HUD bar, restored by double-tapping the top edge. Includes the vibration branch ProMotion 120 FPS pacing fix and Metal 4 effects fallback fix. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
